title: Protective stops
description: An emergency stop resting at the broker for every held position, so the book stays protected when the engine is not running. Width comes from each symbol's own volatility.

enabled.title: Rest protective stops at the broker automatically
enabled.description: Rest protective stops automatically. ON by default: protection constrains rather than acts, so the opt-in rule for new automation does not apply to it. Checks the broker rather than the local cache, and only runs during regular hours.

atrMultiple.title: Stop width (× ATR)
atrMultiple.description: Stop width in ATRs below the high-water mark. Lower is tighter and risks selling on noise; higher protects less.

atrLookback.title: ATR lookback (days)
atrLookback.description: Sessions of true range averaged to measure the symbol's normal daily movement. 14 is the conventional window and matches the order ticket's own ATR stop.

minTrailPct.title: Floor (%)
minTrailPct.description: Never tighter than this, however quiet the symbol. A stop that fires on noise turns a paper wobble into a realised loss.

maxTrailPct.title: Ceiling (%)
maxTrailPct.description: Never wider than this. Past this width a stop is decoration — hitting the ceiling means the position is too volatile for its size.

reprotectOnFill.title: Re-protect automatically after a partial exit
reprotectOnFill.description: Resize the resting stop after a partial exit. Off by default: resizing a resting stop is what stripped protection from five positions on 2026-08-12.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: trail = the account-wide peak-relative trailing stop. entry_floor = a fixed stop at this lane's avg_px_open minus the multiple, set once at placement. none = no broker stop for this lane.

atrMultiple.title: Width (× ATR) for this lane
atrMultiple.description: Overrides the stop width above, for this lane only. Omitted means INHERIT, never zero.

QC345-003_protection.title: QC345 — monthly top-down rotation — protection
QC345-003_protection.description: TRAIL is the account-wide peak-relative stop and the default. ENTRY FLOOR rests a fixed stop at this lane's own entry minus the multiple, set once and never raised. NONE rests nothing and reports the lane as OPTED-OUT — neither covered nor naked.

CRSISHORT-006_protection.title: CRSI short — protection
CRSISHORT-006_protection.description: NONE by declaration (#1029): the adapter carries its own per-short trail and cover, and the plane is long-only, so no stop is rested on a short row regardless. Default = the registry stance; a written key is an override (source=settings).

SMHGLD-007_protection.title: SMHGLD — fixed-weight SMH/GLD sleeve — protection
SMHGLD-007_protection.description: NONE by declaration (#953, #1029): a fixed-weight sleeve rebalancing ~93 times a year; a stop sized to the holding is tripped by its own trims. Reported as OPTED-OUT. Default = the registry stance; a written key is an override (source=settings).
